unit.why: An ethical-homiletic teaching on peace and silence in controversy (R. Yehonatan, Ps. 41), citing in passing a one-line exemplum from R. Moses Botarel's Sefer Yetzirah commentary (a tzaddik called adulterer and robber answers that these forces are in him but unrealized), which is illustration, not a narrated story.
unit.boundary_note: teaching on the R. Yehonatan controversy continues into next division
